characterBible.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL character model sheet for a Traditional Chinese children's picture book, ages 7–9, 'Who Is the Red Mitten Waiting For?'. Delicate flat graphite pencil outlines, scribbled pencil hair, restrained dry colored-pencil accents, expressive original East Asian child faces, white paper grain, NO 3D or photorealism. Pure WHITE background, no scenery, absolutely NO text, labels, letters, logos or watermark. FOUR equal widely spaced columns, full body with all shoes visible, common ground baseline, empty hands, no overlap. Left to right: BOY LANGLANG front; same boy three-quarter; GIRL ROURou front; same girl three-quarter. Both are eight-year-old children of similar height. LANGLANG: short neat BLACK ROUND BOWL HAIRCUT, round expressive face, burnt-orange HOODED duffle COAT with two small dark toggles, navy full-length trousers, teal closed ankle boots, no scarf, no hat. ROUROU: black hair in ONE LOW BRAID resting over her shoulder, soft oval face, PLUM PURPLE knee-length button coat, pale SKY BLUE neck scarf, cream full-length corduroy trousers, dark slate closed shoes. No patterns, logos or extra accessories. Graphite dominates, color mainly in clothes, light skin pencil accents. Characters are distinct from any existing storybook illustration.
